rationale: Both independently found the same real bugs (missing AMD checkmark, false reference-count limitation, FL2VA-partition-blocks-Ref2VA) with strong code-grounded evidence and concrete fixes, so precision and actionability are close. But the ground truth's most repeated concern — the docs build failure (2 CHANGES_REQUESTED reviews, a comment, and a detailed inline comment at supported_models.md:105 about mkdocs --strict and the canonical recipe URL) — is completely absent from X, while Y pinpoints it almost exactly at the same file/line with the correct root cause. Y also digs up additional well-evidenced issues (aiter silent fallback, gfx950 aspect-ratio mismatch) neither in ground truth nor X, without sacrificing grounding.
